rules.armSocket: one separate shoulder adapter per arm; no socket on unused side
rules.armRows: alternate sides, then advance one cell row
rules.transforms: translation and reflection only during construction; uniform scale for whole-creature display
rules.equipment: host-local anchor frames; draw handle behind closed hand
rules.expansion: add complete cells; never stretch a cell or limb

torso-cell.label: Trunk cell
torso-cell.role: Repeat horizontally and vertically. Carries no shoulders, necks, or hips.

side-edge.label: Plain side edge
side-edge.role: Finishes a trunk edge. Replace locally with one shoulder adapter per arm.

top-deck.label: Top deck tile
top-deck.role: Repeat across the top. Neck collars are separate and determine the number of heads.

lower-deck.label: Lower deck tile
lower-deck.role: Interior lower torso tile; hip adapters attach to its surface individually.

lower-endcap.label: Lower left endcap
lower-endcap.role: Finishes the lower outer edge; mirror for the right end. Fixed curvature, no resizing.

shoulder-adapter.label: One shoulder adapter
shoulder-adapter.role: One arm root with its surrounding shoulder tissue. Left side is mirrored.

neck-adapter.label: One neck collar
neck-adapter.role: One neck socket on the top deck. No head is baked into the deck.

hip-adapter.label: One hip adapter
hip-adapter.role: One leg socket in the lower torso. Leg count determines how many are placed.

head.label: Head
head.role: Fixed frontal face; neck and headwear frames stay fixed across variants.

arm-human.label: Arm + closed hand
arm-human.role: Fixed relaxed pose. The whole limb rotates around shoulder; equipment follows grip.

arm-bone.label: Bone arm / same frames
arm-bone.role: Alternate material using exactly the same shoulder, elbow and grip coordinates.

leg-foot.label: Leg + front-facing foot
leg-foot.role: Fixed hip, knee and ankle geometry. Both feet face the viewer.

mace.label: Mace / fixed grip
mace.role: Upright hand-held equipment. Hand must occlude the handle at grip.

boot.label: Boot / front-facing sole
boot.role: Uses the same ankle and sole frame as the leg. No sideways boot perspective.

helmet.label: Helmet / headwear frame
helmet.role: Fixed front-facing headwear envelope aligned to the crown frame.

breastplate.label: Chest plate / local mount
breastplate.role: Fixed patch covering the upper trunk. It does not resize with the whole torso.
